title: South Korean Education Minister Resigns After AI Cheating Scandal
subtitle: The government faces pressure to reform the national exam system following a wave of concerns over high-tech dishonesty.

summary.en: South Korea's Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin has officially resigned following a major exam cheating scandal. The controversy started when a top-scoring candidate admitted to using artificial intelligence and hidden cameras to cheat on a national tax exam. This confession caused panic just days before the annual Suneung college entrance exam. In response, authorities introduced strict, last-minute security measures that affected students nationwide. President Lee Jae Myung has accepted the minister's resignation as the country debates the future of its competitive testing system.
summary.zh: 南韓教育部長崔教振因重大考試舞弊醜聞正式辭職。這場爭議始於一名高分考生坦承在國家稅務考試中使用人工智慧與隱藏式攝影機作弊。這項自白在年度修能大學入學考試前幾天引發恐慌。對此，當局實施了嚴格的臨時安全措施，影響了全國學生。總統李在明已接受部長辭呈，目前全國正針對競爭激烈的考試制度之未來進行辯論。

paragraphs.en: South Korea’s Education Minister, Choi Kyo-jin, has resigned from his position following a national scandal involving cheating with artificial intelligence (AI). The minister announced his decision on Sunday, stating that he takes full responsibility for the confusion caused by emergency measures introduced just before the country’s most important university entrance exam, known as the Suneung.
paragraphs.zh: 南韓教育部長崔教振（Choi Kyo-jin）因一起涉及人工智慧（AI）舞弊的國家級醜聞而辭去職務。部長於週日宣布此決定，表示他對該國最重要的「大學修學能力測驗」（簡稱修能）舉行前夕，因緊急措施所引發的混亂負起全責。

paragraphs.en: The crisis began only a week before the Suneung, when a top-scoring candidate in a national tax accountancy exam admitted to using illegal technology. According to The Guardian, the 34-year-old cheater confessed in a video message that he used a miniature camera to photograph test questions. He then sent these images to an AI system and received the answers on his smartphone. The confession shocked the nation, as the candidate had only answered one out of 160 questions incorrectly.
paragraphs.zh: 這場危機始於修能考試前一週，當時一名國家稅務會計考試的高分考生坦承使用非法科技舞弊。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，這名三十四歲的作弊者在一段影片訊息中供稱，他利用微型攝影機拍攝考題，隨後將影像傳送至人工智慧系統，並透過智慧型手機接收答案。這項自白震驚全國，因為該名考生在一百六十題中僅答錯一題。

paragraphs.en: This admission created a wave of fear regarding academic honesty in South Korea, where standardized tests are seen as the primary path to prestigious universities and successful careers. The Suneung is so important that the country takes extreme steps to ensure it runs smoothly, such as stopping aircraft takeoffs and delaying the opening of the stock market. Because of the sudden cheating scandal, the government felt forced to act quickly to prevent similar incidents during the Suneung, which is taken by about 500,000 students each year.
paragraphs.zh: 這項自白在南韓引發了對學術誠信的恐懼，因為標準化考試被視為進入頂尖大學與獲得成功職涯的主要途徑。修能考試極為重要，以至於國家採取極端手段確保考試順利進行，例如暫停飛機起降以及延後股市開盤。由於這起突發的舞弊醜聞，政府感到必須迅速採取行動，以防止每年約五十萬名考生參加的修能考試出現類似事件。

paragraphs.en: According to the BBC, the ministry introduced a series of urgent, strict rules just days before the exam. These measures included sending emergency alerts to every mobile phone in the country, even those belonging to tourists. The alerts were sent three times during the exam day, causing phones to make noise even if they were set to silent mode. Additionally, students were told to cover buttons on their clothes to prevent the use of hidden cameras, and authorities inspected eyewear to ensure glasses were not actually smart devices. The government also offered a reward of at least $75,000 for anyone who reported cheating or misconduct.
paragraphs.zh: 根據英國廣播公司（BBC）報導，教育部在考試前幾天推出了一系列緊急且嚴格的規定。這些措施包括向全國每一支手機發送緊急警報，即便是遊客的手機也不例外。警報在考試當天發送了三次，導致手機即便設定為靜音模式也會發出聲響。此外，學生被要求遮蓋衣物上的鈕扣以防使用隱藏式攝影機，當局也檢查了眼鏡，確保其並非智慧裝置。政府還提供至少七萬五千美元的獎金，給予舉報舞弊或違規行為的人。

paragraphs.en: These last-minute changes caused significant stress for students. Some high school seniors told the Korea Times that they were worried their regular glasses would be mistaken for smart devices, leading some to switch to contact lenses just to avoid suspicion. Despite the government's efforts, the response was criticized by teachers' unions as being too late. Furthermore, the minister faced public backlash after a parliamentary hearing on Monday. When asked if he was confident that authorities could catch cheaters on exam day, Choi, 72, replied that he was not confident due to his age. This comment drew sharp criticism from the public.
paragraphs.zh: 這些臨時的變動對學生造成了巨大的壓力。一些高中應屆畢業生向《韓國時報》（Korea Times）表示，他們擔心自己的普通眼鏡會被誤認為智慧裝置，導致一些人為了避免被懷疑而改戴隱形眼鏡。儘管政府做出努力，但此舉仍遭教師工會批評為時已晚。此外，部長在週一的國會聽證會後面臨公眾強烈反彈。當被問及是否有信心當局能在考試當天抓到作弊者時，七十二歲的崔教振回答因年事已高而沒有信心。這番言論引發公眾嚴厲批評。

paragraphs.en: In his resignation statement, which was reported by the BBC and The Guardian, Choi admitted that he could not escape criticism for failing to prepare for such risks in advance. He noted that while the exam concluded without any major incidents, he felt a deep sense of responsibility. President Lee Jae Myung, who has been calling for a complete overhaul—or a major change—of the current exam system, accepted the resignation.
paragraphs.zh: 在BBC與《衛報》報導的辭職聲明中，崔教振承認他無法逃避因未能提前為此類風險做好準備而受到的批評。他指出，雖然考試在沒有重大事故的情況下結束，但他感到深切的責任。總統李在明（Lee Jae Myung）一直呼籲對現行考試制度進行全面改革，他已接受了這項辭呈。

paragraphs.en: Following the exam, the education ministry reported that 111 candidates were found with unauthorized smart devices. The scandal has sparked a wider conversation about the pressure placed on students in South Korea. Because the Suneung is viewed as a ticket to well-paid jobs and even better marriage prospects, the competition is incredibly fierce. The government has now promised that in the future, all smart devices must be turned off and handed in before the start of the exam.
paragraphs.zh: 考試結束後，教育部報告指出有一百一十一名考生被發現攜帶未經授權的智慧裝置。這起醜聞引發了關於南韓學生所承受壓力的廣泛討論。由於修能考試被視為獲得高薪工作甚至更好婚姻前景的門票，競爭極為激烈。政府現已承諾，未來所有智慧裝置必須在考試開始前關機並上繳。

paragraphs.en: As the country looks forward, many are wondering how the government will change the testing process to prevent future cheating while reducing the intense pressure on students. The resignation of Minister Choi marks a significant moment in this ongoing debate, highlighting the challenges of maintaining fairness in an era where technology makes cheating easier than ever before. For now, the focus remains on how to restore public trust in the national education system.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著國家展望未來，許多人都在思考政府將如何改變考試流程，以防止未來舞弊並減輕學生承受的巨大壓力。崔部長的辭職標誌著這場持續辯論中的重要時刻，凸顯了在科技使舞弊比以往任何時候都更容易的時代，維持公平性所面臨的挑戰。目前，焦點仍放在如何恢復公眾對國家教育體系的信任。

previousArticles.summaryEn: South Korea's Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin has resigned after a major cheating scandal involving artificial intelligence. The controversy began when a top-scoring candidate admitted to using a micro-camera and AI tools to cheat on a tax accountancy exam. This confession caused widespread panic just days before the annual Suneung, the country's crucial college entrance exam. In response, the government introduced strict new rules, including emergency mobile phone alerts and clothing restrictions. President Lee Jae Myung accepted the minister's resignation following public criticism over the government's handling of the situation.

quiz.question: What specific actions did the government take to prevent cheating during the Suneung exam?

options.A: They banned all students from wearing glasses or contact lenses during the test.
options.B: They sent emergency mobile alerts and inspected students' eyewear for smart technology.
options.C: They canceled the exam for students who were found with unauthorized smart devices.
options.D: They required all students to hand in their smartphones and laptops the day before the exam.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段，政府採取了多項緊急措施，包括發送手機緊急警報以及檢查學生的眼鏡，以確保其非智慧裝置。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到學生是擔心眼鏡被誤認才主動換成隱形眼鏡，政府並未禁止配戴。選項 C 雖提到有 111 名考生被發現攜帶裝置，但文章未說明這些學生是否被取消資格。選項 D 不正確，因為文章最後一段才提到政府承諾未來將實施此政策，而非當時的緊急措施。

quiz.question: Why did Minister Choi Kyo-jin’s comment during the parliamentary hearing likely contribute to his resignation?

options.A: He admitted that he had personally helped a candidate cheat using AI.
options.B: He suggested that the Suneung exam should be completely abolished immediately.
options.C: He showed a lack of confidence in the government's ability to maintain exam integrity.
options.D: He blamed the students for the stress caused by the last-minute emergency rules.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第五段，當被問及是否有信心抓到作弊者時，Choi 部長坦言因年齡問題而「沒有信心」。這番話顯示負責教育的官員對考試公平性缺乏掌控力，引發公眾強烈反彈，導致他必須為此辭職。選項 A 無中生有；選項 B 錯誤，因為提議改革的是總統李在明；選項 D 錯誤，文章中並未提到部長責怪學生，反而是學生因規則感到壓力。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'overhaul' mean in the context of the exam system?

options.A: A complete and thorough reform or change.
options.B: A temporary pause or delay in operations.
options.C: A minor adjustment to improve efficiency.
options.D: A secret investigation into past scandals.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到總統 Lee Jae Myung 呼籲對現行考試制度進行「complete overhaul」，隨後括號解釋為「a major change」。這表示要對體制進行徹底的翻修或改革。選項 B 是對考試過程的描述（如延遲開市），而非 overhaul 的意思；選項 C 指的是微調，與 major change 相悖；選項 D 則完全偏離了 overhaul 作為「改革」的本意。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article?

options.A: The South Korean government successfully eliminated all forms of cheating in exams.
options.B: The Suneung exam is no longer considered important for South Korean students.
options.C: AI technology has made it impossible for any government to hold fair standardized tests.
options.D: A cheating scandal and the subsequent government response led to a ministerial resignation and a debate on exam fairness.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章開頭介紹了部長因 AI 作弊醜聞辭職，中間討論了政府的緊急應對措施及其帶來的壓力與爭議，最後總結了此事件對教育系統公平性與未來改革的影響，涵蓋了全文核心。選項 A 與事實不符，因為仍有 111 人被抓；選項 B 錯誤，文章強調 Suneung 依然極度重要；選項 C 過於誇大，文章僅指出技術讓作弊變得更容易，而非「不可能」維持公平。
